item.title: please oh cruel world save my scp
item.content:encoded:
what a world we have come to my lifelong dream of creating a scp to go on the site is ruined, i only wanted to please the scp moderator and are now being punished for my ways; please forgive my soul and any changes that need to be made can do so. save my precious scp.

thank you

lots of love xx
